instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React Native JS components, NO typescript (.js/.jsx files).
Implement the UI using StyleSheet with the exact colors provided.
Do NOT use emojis for icons, use @expo/vector-icons.
Use the layout guidelines to place elements exactly as specified in the screenshots.
Maintain the light theme with Cream/Beige background (#F5EFE0) as default.
Ensure section labels match exactly: uppercase, gold/yellow, bold.
Stack the right-side FABs vertically above the main FAB, leaving enough padding for the SOS button on the left.
